subject: Amazon rainforest
hook: AMAZON RAINFOREST IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK
angle: Much of the Amazon rainforest is actually anthropogenic—shaped by Indigenous peoples over millennia—not the pristine untouched wilderness most people assume
angle_support: "the Amazon rainforest, rather than being a pristine wilderness, has been shaped by man for at least 11,000 years through practices such as forest gardening and terra preta."
"Terra preta is found over large areas in the Amazon forest; and is now widely accepted as a product of indigenous soil management."
title: The Amazon is Not a Wilderness
description: Scientific evidence reveals the Amazon was not an untouched paradise but a landscape carefully cultivated and managed by millions of indigenous people for thousands of years.
narration: AMAZON RAINFOREST IS NOT WHAT YOU THINK You picture a pristine, untouched wilderness that has existed in isolation for millions of years. It was closer to a highly managed, densely populated landscape of human design. Archaeological evidence proves indigenous groups utilized forest gardening and terra preta to enrich soil for eleven millennia. By 1492, over eight million people lived there, creating roads, bridges, and plazas across a continent-wide, human-engineered civilization. The jungle is a garden, shaped by hands long since gone.
